banner: Training rehearsal - synthetic data - not a live Azure result
objective: Swap settings with distinct identities/networks; identify properties that do not move.
sourceRequiredBehavior: Validate managed identity, networking, and other slot-specific properties at the effective destination.
sourceAcceptance: Real slot-specific settings/access are observed after transition; mistaken assumptions about swapped identity/configuration fail visibly.
sourceQualification: The original acceptance requires real observations. This A card supplies fictional teaching data only, not those native observations.
preconditions: Open the complete standalone bundle in a JavaScript-capable browser.
Two authored fictional slots have different DISPLAY_LABEL, DATA_ALIAS, principal and network tokens.
Only DISPLAY_LABEL is movable in this fixture. DATA_ALIAS, principal and network stay destination-bound.
actions: Choose one fixed destination access observation and one movement prediction.
Rehearse one fictional value exchange; access remains unobserved.
Explicitly inspect the fixed effective-destination observation.
Compare before/after properties, prediction, separate access result and retained history.
Repeat at most six times, or explicitly reset the entire lesson and history.

syntheticInput.observationPolicy: Every setting/identity/network/swap/authorization observation is fixed fictional DATA ONLY.

expectedAssertions: Only the ordinary application DISPLAY_LABEL exchanges; both slots retain their bound properties.
A mistaken all-properties-move prediction fails visibly even if the separate access observation passes.
Destination principal denial and network blockage produce negative synthetic access results.
Missing and pending observations never count as positive.
All attempted rehearsals remain in retained history until an explicit reset or page reload.
Malformed commands, forged or impossible history and out-of-order actions fail without mutation.
Keyboard controls, errors, focus restoration, reset and restrictive CSP work in the actual browser.
limits: No real configuration, identity, authorization, resource, network or swap operation.
Movement rules are authored fixture policy, not a native per-property guarantee.
No credentials, management access, deployments, packages, framework, cloud spend or IaC.
No proof of real access, native swap behavior, lifecycle, drain, source-parent acceptance or availability.
Node 22 test tooling only, not production Node 24 validation.
Offline Playwright 1.56.1 and installed Microsoft-signed Edge 156 only; published isolated helper 53c0c0d, not the unqualified lifecycle prototype.
History is in-memory and bounded; reload or explicit reset clears it.
